title: Connectors & Register
description: Practice advanced connectors and choosing the right register for context.

questions.prompt: Which connector best means 'nevertheless' in a formal text?
questions.explanation: 'No entanto' is a formal connector meaning 'nevertheless' or 'however'.

questions.prompt: Complete: ___ os dados sejam limitados, a conclusão é plausível.
questions.explanation: 'Embora' introduces concession and takes the subjunctive 'sejam'.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is most appropriate in a formal email?
questions.explanation: 'Solicito' is formal and suitable for professional correspondence.

questions.prompt: What is the function of 'por conseguinte'?
Translate formally: 'We remain available for any questions.'
options: Permanecemos à disposição para quaisquer dúvidas.

questions.answer: Permanecemos à disposição para quaisquer dúvidas.
questions.explanation: This is a polished, formal closing phrase in Brazilian Portuguese.
